WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_recordvault_count
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(step1.distinct_recordvault_count) AS total_distinct_recordvault
  FROM step1
)
SELECT
  step1.orderbase,
  step1.avg_fillcount,
  step1.distinct_recordvault_count,
  CAST(step1.distinct_recordvault_count AS REAL) / step2.total_distinct_recordvault AS ratio
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.total_distinct_recordvault IS NOT NULL
